title: Cache stampede on pricing-service after Redis eviction/restart
description: pricing-cache (Redis) restarted and came back with an empty cache; the entire pricing read path hit the pricing-db origin simultaneously. Origin CPU saturated, connection pools exhausted, and pricing read latency spiked minutes after the cache event — the load spike is directly correlated in time with the Redis restart, not with organic traffic growth.

raw_events.description: Node drain on k3-worker-02 rescheduled the Redis pod; restart completed 18:27:41 with an empty cache (no AOF/RDB restore configured)
TTL jitter and request coalescing disabled during a past tuning change; stampede protection absent
